body:
CHANGELOG updated in PAPERCRAFT: S206-59: more forgiving connection-loss thresholds for low bandwidth. Founder real-time (after confirming the full v0.12.0 pipeline -- login, movement, mouse-look, ping -- works over real 5G): "we are getting a lot of connection lost can we get it to be more forgiving for low bandwidth?" Real, coupled fix -- both thresholds bumped together, kept proportional: apps/server's own PC_PLAYER_TIMEOUT_MS 30000 -> 60000ms, apps/client's own PC_CLIENT_STALE_MS (the disruptive full-screen takeover) 20000 -> 45000ms, still a real 15s safety margin under the server's own new eviction window. The short, non-disruptive PC_CLIENT_WEAK_MS (2000ms) indicator is unchanged. README.md/NORTHSTAR.md updated (stale documented numbers). v0.14.0 released. Live production server binary rebuilt in place; restart queued (41-restart-papercraft-server-for-low-bandwidth-thresholds.sh). (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)
